limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; no biological, assay or clinical validity is established.
Exact Poisson intervals assume independent counts and known exposures; countability selection can affect coverage.
The below-countable detection convention is a model-based upper bound, never a validated assay detection limit. Above-countable bounds are range bounds, not confidence intervals.
Hashes cannot establish historical freeze timing or true source independence. The pack always leaves independent review unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, steril*, safe* and poten*. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; one synthetic fixture never establishes replication.
Inputs are read-only, bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
